# Quantities

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List quantities

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/quantities`

Retrieve a paginated list of quantities with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: product, location, storageCategory, lot, package, partner, user, company, creator | `product,location` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[product_id]` | string | No | Filter by product IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[location_id]` | string | No | Filter by location IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[lot_id]` | string | No | Filter by lot IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[package_id]` | string | No | Filter by package IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[inventory_quantity_set]` | string | No | Filter by inventory quantity set (0 or 1) | `1` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-updated_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/quantities?include=product%2Clocation&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bproduct_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Blocation_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Blot_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bpackage_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Binventory_quantity_set%5D=1&sort=-updated_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

## Create quantity

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/quantities`

Create a new product quantity count

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `location_id` | integer | Yes | Inventory location ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `product_id` | integer | Yes | Product ID. Configurable products are not allowed; pass a variant product ID instead. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `storage_category_id` | integer | No | Storage category ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `lot_id` | integer | No | Lot ID. Required for lot/serial tracked products and must belong to the selected product. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `package_id` | integer | No | Package ID. Must belong to the selected location. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `partner_id` | integer | No | Owner partner ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `user_id` | integer | No | Responsible user ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `counted_quantity` | number | Yes | Counted quantity entered during inventory adjustment. For serial-tracked products, this must be 0 or 1. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `scheduled_at` | string | No | Scheduled inventory date. Must be a valid date. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/quantities" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "location_id": 1,
  "product_id": 1,
  "storage_category_id": 1,
  "lot_id": 1,
  "package_id": 1,
  "partner_id": 1,
  "user_id": 1,
  "company_id": 1,
  "counted_quantity": 25,
  "scheduled_at": "2026-02-25"
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/quantities", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "location_id": 1,
  "product_id": 1,
  "storage_category_id": 1,
  "lot_id": 1,
  "package_id": 1,
  "partner_id": 1,
  "user_id": 1,
  "company_id": 1,
  "counted_quantity": 25,
  "scheduled_at": "2026-02-25"
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```
